description: This file contains utility functions for handling and validating relative paths within a sandboxed environment, including path resolution, boundary checks, and platform-specific path normalization.

methods.name: throwPathEscapesBoundary
methods.description: Throws an error if a path escapes the defined boundary, including boundary label and optional root in error message.

methods.name: validateRelativePathWithinBoundary
methods.description: Validates that a relative path does not escape its boundary, throws error if invalid.

methods.name: toRelativePathUnderRoot
methods.description: Converts a candidate path to a relative path under a specified root, considering platform-specific path resolution.

methods.name: toRelativeBoundaryPath
methods.description: Wraps toRelativePathUnderRoot with boundary label and options.

methods.name: toRelativeWorkspacePath
methods.description: Generates a relative path from the workspace root to a candidate path.

methods.name: toRelativeSandboxPath
methods.description: Generates a relative path from the sandbox root to a candidate path, including root in error if invalid.

methods.name: resolvePathFromInput
methods.description: Resolves and normalizes a file path based on input and current working directory.
